newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Suharto wants sufficient food ahead of polls.
newsitem.headline: Suharto wants sufficient food ahead of polls.

text.p: Indonesian President Suharto on Wednesday ordered the state logistics agency (BULOG) to ensure there was sufficient food in the country ahead of the general elections next month.
BULOG chief Beddu Amang quoted Suharto as saying during a meeting with him that the 75-year-old leader wanted food supplies to be monitored.
"Yes, that means districts which are not having harvests ... there should also be stocks there. Particularly with the coming election," Amang told reporters.
He said the country had sufficient stocks of essential food items such as rice, wheat flour, soybean and sugar.
"The president wanted us to continue monitoring the situation ... to follow developments on prices," he said.
Amang said the country had a rice stockpile of 2.4 million tonnes, which he described as quite large, and that harvests were proceeding in some regions.
Indonesians go to the polls on May 29.
